additional_info.subject: Note for the expert
additional_info.body:
Internal discussion is going on with Mr. Joao as he is already working on same charger with same issue
Tesla Model 3 2021 model-->As we checked the logs in given timestamp-19/02, 04:09hrs (UTC)-->DC2
Charging Cable Sensor Validation Error--->
Charging session interruption due to plausibility check on the temperature sensors inside the plug. This could be related to poor contact between the plug and car socket, which can cause one DC pin to reach a higher temperature than the other, especially during high-current sessions.
